title: Two-factor authentication
off: Off. Besides the password, signing in can also require a code from an app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
codesLow: You are running out of recovery codes. Generate new ones.
requiredHint: Required by these spaces: {spaces}. You cannot sign in to them without it.

code.anyHint: Or one of your recovery codes.

enable.passwordIntro: Confirm your password to turn it on.
enable.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually. Then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
enable.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
enable.expired: The setup has expired (it lasts 10 minutes). Enter your password and start again.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.warning: Store them somewhere safe. Each code can be used once instead of an app code, e.g. when you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
codes.fileHeader: InvoiceApp recovery codes for {email}. Each works only once.

regenerate.intro: Generates 10 new recovery codes; the current ones stop working.

disable.intro: Signing in will then be protected by the password alone.
disable.requiredBy: These spaces require two-factor authentication. Turning it off signs you out of them at once, your API tokens there stop working, and you can sign in again only after turning it back on:
